bug_semantics: The API scope middleware derives write versus read permission solely from the HTTP method and therefore treats every GET as read-only. The GET runner registration-token handlers are not read-only: shared.GetRegistrationToken calls NewRunnerToken when no active token exists and returns the usable token. A leaked read:user token (or the corresponding read-scoped owner/repository token) can consequently mint or obtain a runner registration credential, register an attacker-controlled Actions runner, and receive workflow work exposing source and repository secrets.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable GET-plus-create design first appears in PR #27144 source member eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f, which added the shared state-mutating handler and reachable organization/admin GET routes; member bba250f3e99bef12bbd9a1d9d790ab8155c999d5 then added the user and repository GET routes. GitHub squashed the 22-member PR into mainline aggregate baf0d402d9cb47849394202fcfc7c2e23b0faac3, so that aggregate is not the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: absent — BIC commit object has no AI author/co-author/Generated-with marker; see evidence
evidence: Mechanism: at the BIC tree, `grep` of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/go-gitea/gitea/eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f/routers/api/v1/api.go shows tokenRequiresScopes initializes `requiredScopeLevel := auth_model.Read` and changes it to Write only for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE (lines 241-264). `gh api repos/go-gitea/gitea/commits/eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f --jq` shows its new routers/api/v1/shared/runners.go calling GetUnactivatedRunnerToken and, on missing/inactive token, NewRunnerToken, then returning the token; its api.go patch registers GET organization and admin registration-token routes. Thus the state change was reachable through a request authorized as read from the first causal source commit.

Attack path: `routers/api/actions/runner/runner.go` Register lines 41-103 accepts the supplied registration token with actions_model.GetRunnerToken, rejects only missing/inactive tokens, creates an ActionRunner scoped by the token OwnerID/RepoID, and returns the runner's operational token. This directly connects the disclosed GET token to registration of an attacker-controlled Actions runner; the advisory/NVD description records the resulting workflow access to repository source and secrets.

Mainline trace and squash: `git log --all -S'm.Get("/registration-token"' -- routers/api/v1/api.go` identifies baf0d402d9cb47849394202fcfc7c2e23b0faac3 as the addition and 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad as the removal; `git log -L 1048,1048:routers/api/v1/api.go 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad^` traces the user GET line to baf0d402d9cb47849394202fcfc7c2e23b0faac3. `gh api repos/go-gitea/gitea/pulls/27144` reports 22 commits, head f0e7edf97244ec02c4e07213043a6a676ca5364f, base 4c29c75968f520123f125e8305b2c29198664251, and merge_commit_sha baf0d402d9cb47849394202fcfc7c2e23b0faac3, proving baf0d402... is the squash aggregate.

Decomposition: `gh api 'repos/go-gitea/gitea/pulls/27144/commits?per_page=100'` lists eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f first. `gh api repos/go-gitea/gitea/commits/eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f` shows that member adding routers/api/v1/shared/runners.go plus the organization/admin GET routes. The same endpoint for bba250f3e99bef12bbd9a1d9d790ab8155c999d5 shows the later user handler and both user/repository GET route additions. eec5ed... is therefore the earliest and smallest already-vulnerable member, while bba250... only expands the affected scopes.

Direct parent absence: the Git commit object for eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f names sole parent 24a215e317103471aeb864f365089a36076efc1d. `gh api 'repos/go-gitea/gitea/contents/routers/api/v1/api.go?ref=24a215e317103471aeb864f365089a36076efc1d' --jq '.content | @base64d | contains("/registration-token")'` returns false, and requesting routers/api/v1/shared/runners.go at that parent returns HTTP 404. The mainline squash parent independently has no matching route or handler: `git grep -n 'registration-token\|GetRegistrationToken' 4c29c75968f520123f125e8305b2c29198664251 -- routers/api/v1` returns no matches.

Version boundary: `git grep -n 'registration-token' v1.21.11 -- routers/api/v1/api.go routers/api/v1/shared/runners.go` returns no matches. At v1.22.0, `git grep -n 'm.Get("/registration-token"\|requiredScopeLevel := auth_model.Read\|NewRunnerToken'` finds the read-default classifier, three GET routes, and the token creation call, so v1.22.0 is the first affected stable release. `git tag --contains baf0d402d9cb47849394202fcfc7c2e23b0faac3 --sort=version:refname` likewise starts at v1.22.0.

Fix and closing boundary: `git show 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad` (PR #36801, 'Remove API registration-token') deletes all GET registration-token routes and their GET handlers while retaining the separate POST creation API; its sole parent is 7889b78c8736a8a03bff423f7dfb535ac15281d7 and still contains those GETs. `git tag --contains 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad --sort=version:refname` starts at v1.26.0-rc0 and then v1.26.0. `git grep -n 'registration-token' v1.26.0 -- routers/api/v1/api.go` shows POST routes only, establishing v1.26.0 as the first fixed stable release.

Referenced-tag caveat, directly verified: despite appearing in the advisory references, v1.25.5 is not fixed. `git grep -n 'm.Get("/registration-token"' v1.25.5 -- routers/api/v1/api.go` returns the repository/owner, user, and admin GET routes; `git tag --contains 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad` does not include v1.25.5. The reproducible code/tag boundary is therefore affected v1.22.0 through v1.25.5, fixed in v1.26.0 stable.

BIC-only AI check: `gh api repos/go-gitea/gitea/git/commits/eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f` returns author and committer Lunny Xiao <xiaolunwen@gmail.com> and the one-line message 'Add get actions runner registration token for API routes, repo, org and global level'. The exact source-member commit object has no Co-authored-by trailer, Generated-with trailer, bot identity, Copilot attribution, or other AI marker. The later squash object's human trailers and the fix object's metadata are not used for the verdict.

First-party closure: GitHub PR #36801 is the direct removal PR and merged as 716a800f500348e10a663ad749398d230c5bb7ad on 2026-03-02. Its discussion explicitly focuses on the GET-only endpoints and the existence of POST creation endpoints, matching the deletion diff and the method/scope mismatch described by CVE-2026-24059/GHSA-M7QQ-F4RG-V5M5.
reasoning: The vulnerability was already real in the first PR source member: scoped-token middleware predated it and classified its GET as read, while that GET could create and disclose a registration credential. Because PR #27144 was squashed, the mainline commit is only an aggregate; decomposing the PR makes eec5ed07521ffc767c0dd1bdccdece8a7f54fe3f the smallest BIC, with direct parent absence proven. bba250f3e99bef12bbd9a1d9d790ab8155c999d5 expanded the same flaw to the headline user and repository routes but did not originate it. The direct fix removes the unsafe GET surface, and tag contents establish the actual first-fixed stable version independently of the advisory's anomalous v1.25.5 reference. The BIC commit object is wholly human-attributed and contains no AI marker, so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
